title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - C-23
notes:
West leads the ♦J against 4♥. The opening lead is won by South. The ♠A must be lost and the trump suit is far from solid. South must try to hold his trump losers to 2.

There is a sure way to play the heart combination for no more than 2 losers provided hearts are no worse than 4-1. South begins by cashing the ♥A.

When both defenders follow low (if an honour drops, there is no problem), South should cross in clubs and lead a second round of trump towards the dummy. If West follows low, the play of the ♥Q will guarantee no more than 2 trump losers. If West follows with the ♥K or ♥J, again there will be no problem.

If West discards when a trump is played towards dummy, the ♥Q is played. East will win the ♥K, but South can later lead from dummy towards the ♥10, holding his trump losers to 2.
